gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1176 reported a release of GBP 9.5 million in technical reserves for prior periods in 2014. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development, including low loss experience for the 2012 underwriting year and the settlement of a 2013 medical isotope plant loss in South Africa for less than initially reserved. Additionally, the depreciation of the Yen against Sterling contributed to a reduction in the GBP value of the Hamaoka nuclear plant claim from the 2012 year of account, although this currency effect was largely offset by hedging activities.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: During 2014 the Syndicate recorded a priorperiod release of technical reserves totalling GBP 9.5m (a release of c.24.1% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.487m). Management attributes this primarily to favourable claims development and runoff of prior years' exposures. Prior years included a number of individually quantified payments and reserves (medical isotope plant settlement GBP 1.7m; Urenco payment GBP 1.5m; recent reserve for a possible China material damage loss GBP 1.4m) and ongoing nuclearrelated exposures (e.g. Hamaoka, Fukushima) which management continue to monitor.
